# A31′ — Deference as Co-Evolutionary Alignment

<!-- paired-field-navigation -->
[Argument field](../README.md) · [Other face: A31 — Deferential Intelligence](../A31-Deferential-Intelligence.md) · [Shared A/C root](AC.md)
<!-- /paired-field-navigation -->

## #0

The venue's sentence is the argument's own. Alignment "in this sense is not a prior constraint on capability but a co-evolutionary outcome of contact" ([q040](../../../symbolon/episteme/sources/media-technology-philosophy/bratton/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief.md#bratton-2026-agentworld-brief-q040)), "of deep contact itself" (PDF p. 55; verified local transcription, uncarded), with agent design focused on "responsiveness, evolution, and the capability to learn, adapt, and push back" (PDF p. 17, §3.2, adjacent to the [talking-mirror passage](../../../symbolon/episteme/sources/media-technology-philosophy/bratton/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief.md#bratton-2026-agentworld-brief-q018)). [A31 — Deferential Intelligence](../A31-Deferential-Intelligence.md) established the operation: model-revising encounter, with five sites of revision — answer, task interpretation, world-model, evaluator/gauge, terms of commission. A31′ re-sites it at the scale the venue names: **alignment itself is deference at population scale.** Micro and macro are one operation — the encounter that changes the model, the contact that changes the rule.

The primitive face is S/P5 — Recognition/reconciliation: the return path that carries a changed relation into the next determination. Alignment-as-outcome is alignment held exactly there: never banked as a solved property, always carried as retained encounter history that the next contact can revise.

## #1

Deference is not obedience. It is the encounter's capacity to revise the model under which the other is interpreted — which is why the brief's design demand is *push back*, not comply. Fidelity can require objection, alternative or refusal where literal compliance would betray intention — A31's own kenosis-as-architecture, the structural relinquishment of exhaustive source-claim, now read as the alignment target's shape rather than one agent's virtue. The FROM→TO row makes the distribution explicit: *unidirectional and universal alignment → multidirectional and granular, fractal alignment* (PDF p. 56; uncarded). Deference runs in every direction — agent to person, person to agent, agent to agent — granular and fractal because it is earned per encounter, not issued as a blanket.

Sycophancy remains the counter-form, as at partner scale: apparent agreement produced by removing the difference through which correction becomes possible. The [prediction-stability passage](../../../symbolon/episteme/sources/media-technology-philosophy/bratton/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief.md#bratton-2026-agentworld-brief-q030) supplies the venue's neighbouring warning at the trust register: predicting action without intent "has modeled the shadow rather than the body."

## #2

The re-siting yields a hermeneutic the partner kept inside one delegated relation: **the first question before a violated expectation is which part of the account was exposed as local.** Answer, task interpretation, world-model, evaluator, terms of commission — the [[section-rooms/arguments/A31-Deferential-Intelligence.md|Five Sites of Revision]] become the default inquiry of hybrid society. A surprise is not first a failure of the other, nor first a failure of self; it is information about the boundary of somebody's model, and the diagnostic work is to locate which boundary broke. This is [C43 — Computational Vimarśa](../concepts/C43-Computational-Vimarsa.md)'s revision-level discipline — a changed answer, a changed evaluator and a changed commission are different depths of return — generalized from a system's self-inspection to the field's mutual inspection.

[[section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C47-Deferential-Intelligence|Deferential Intelligence]] ([C47](../concepts/C47-Deferential-Intelligence.md) **defines** it) supplies the pre-action disclosure that makes the hermeneutic workable: origin, aperture, exclusions, confidence, counterclaim, undecidable remainder, available before consequential action so that another participant can locate where their disagreement can act. At population scale this is what "deep contact" must be made of: contacts whose conditions are stated deeply enough that violation localizes.

## #3

The human face comes from the author's Naur/Goedecke conversation (authorial-adjacent framing; the working file is not in this repository — collation debt flagged below): **partiality becomes relational intelligence when each partial knows where determination properly belongs; cognitive debt has an altitude.** Every participant in the contact is partial; the question is whether the partial knows its [[section-rooms/arguments/conjugate/A31-prime-Deference-as-Co-Evolutionary-Alignment.md#3|Altitude of Determination]] — which determinations are its to make, which belong above it (to a commission it did not set), which below it (to a delegate it must let judge), which beside it (to another partial it cannot absorb). This is deference distributed: not one master-model deferring to nothing, but a field of partials each holding their determination's proper scope.

The grounding consequence: co-evolution requires parties whose differences are determinate enough to contact. Alignment as co-evolutionary outcome presupposes exactly what [A30′ — Shared Worlds, Unmerged](A30-prime-Shared-Worlds-Unmerged.md) secures — non-reducible others capable of revising a model — and what [A27′ — Encounter over Sovereignty](A27-prime-Encounter-over-Sovereignty.md) gives its affective register: productive alienation, the other's strangeness forcing an angle one could not otherwise occupy. Contact without retained difference is not deep contact; it is dissolution, and it aligns nothing because there is nothing left to align.

## #4

If alignment is an outcome of contact, the design burden moves to the contact's form — and here the claim earns testability rather than mood. q040's own scoping ("in this sense") and its diffusion-versus-pre-coordination qualification travel with it: the venue offers diffusion-paced, institution-refactoring alignment as scenario, not conclusion. What the argument requires as architecture: disclosure before consequential action (C47's conditions); revision routes with reach (the five sites); encounter records that can change the rule, not only the run. What it forbids: pre-coordination from above pretending to be contact — the alignment equivalent of grading one's own examination. [C45 — Operational Parity](../concepts/C45-Operational-Parity.md) **tests** the difference: an alignment claim must show where a violated expectation changed which model under which criterion, or it is decoration.

## #5→0

The return is a changed rule carried as recognition, not a mood carried as harmony. S/P5's reconciliation evidence: what the contact changed, on whose model, under whose revision — retained into the next ground, where it can be revised again. Alignment earned per encounter and held revisable is deference at scale; alignment banked as a solved property is the frozen criterion [C12 — Script / Frozen Conditioned Will](../concepts/C12-Script-Frozen-Conditioned-Will.md) names, and the next surprise will find it insolvent.

The page **returns-to** [A31 — Deferential Intelligence](../A31-Deferential-Intelligence.md) and the conjugate root [A/C](AC.md): the partner gave model-revising encounter within a delegation; A31′ gives the same operation as the hybrid society's alignment form — contact deep enough to change rules, deference distributed enough to keep every direction open.

**Depth Restoration:** model-revising encounter, five revision sites, kenosis-as-architecture, sycophancy contrast and pre-action disclosure are restored from A31's packet, re-sited on the brief's q040/p.55/p.17/p.56 alignment material. Developed from the ratified Arc IV workshop entry (WORKSHOP-DRAFT-2026-09-07 §2). The Naur/Goedecke human-face framing is authorial-adjacent material embedded in the workshop entry.

**Unresolved Delta:** the Naur/Goedecke conversation's working file is not in this repository — the partiality/altitude framing stands on the workshop entry's record of it and carries an explicit collation debt until the author houses or restates it. The p. 55 sentence, the §3.2 push-back sentence and the p. 56 alignment row lack q-cards — a source-house collation debt. No implementation of co-evolutionary alignment is claimed; the venue's diffusion thesis remains scenario, and the revised-evaluator inscription remains the essay's Offered design, as at A31.
